title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_242.txt
concise_summary: This short segment completes the St. Sophia 'satori': the female hypostasis of Christ — Form II of Form I taking female form — is St. Sophia, already existing and speaking to him now in the lower (Form II) realm, breaking astral determinism by entering history with power, wisdom, and love. Dick calls this one of the most exciting realizations of his four-year *Exegesis*, a confirmation of his 'two-source cosmogony' that explains the early revelation of Christ's female nature and its cosmic role in the soteriological drama. He insists this is no abstract 'theology-spinning' (as Doris calls it): it happened to him personally in 3-74 and to the world historically in 8-74 (with the end of the Vietnam war the next year) — the 'eleventh hour' divine intervention that turned a US police state and imperial tyranny back into a free republic.
key_claims: St. Sophia is the female hypostasis: the Form II (female) hypostasis of Form I/Christ is St. Sophia, already existing and speaking to Dick now.
Sophia in the lower realm: she is here in the Form II realm breaking astral determinism, having entered history and redirected it with power, wisdom, and love.
Confirms two-source cosmogony: this satori confirms the two-source cosmogony and explains the early revelation of Christ's female nature.
Eleventh-hour intervention: this is the 'eleventh hour' divine intervention halting creation's decline at a crucial time and in a crucial way.
Personal and historical: it happened to him personally in 3-74 and to the world historically in 8-74 (plus the end of the Vietnam war the next year).
Concrete political effect: this was no abstraction — it turned a US police state and imperial tyranny back into a free republic.
